items.title: Protein disulphide isomerase protects against ALS/FTD phenotypes associated with cyclin F in zebrafish and cellular models.
items.summary: Mutations in CCNF , encoding cyclin F, cause a small proportion of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and frontotemporal dementia (FTD) cases. Mutant cyclin F mislocalises from the nucleus to the cytoplasm, impairs the ubiquitin proteasome system, disrupts endoplasmic reticulum (ER) to Golgi transport, and triggers ER stress and apoptosis. Protein disulphide isomerase (PDI), a redox-active ER chaperone of the thioredoxin superfamily, protects against ALS phenotypes induced by mutant SOD1, TDP-43, and FUS, but its activity against mutant cyclin F has not been examined. To test whether PDI overexpression prevents the cellular and behavioural phenotypes induced by the ALS/FTD-associated cyclin F S621G mutation. Neuro-2a cells were co-transfected with mCherry-tagged wild-type or mutant cyclin F S621G and V5-tagged PDI or empty vector. Subcellular localisation, XBP-1 and CHOP activation, proteasome reporter (GFPu) accumulation, nuclear morphology, and cleaved caspase-3 immunoreactivity were assessed by confocal microscopy. Transient transgenic zebrafish larvae generated by mRNA co-injection of cyclin F and PDI were assessed by photomotor response at 48 h post-fertilisation. Mutant cyclin F S621G induced cytoplasmic mislocalisation, ER stress (assessed by XBP-1 and CHOP activation), proteasome dysfunction (indicated by GFPu accumulation), and apoptosis (assessed by nuclear condensation and caspase-3 activation), all of which were significantly attenuated by PDI co-expression. Zebrafish larvae expressing cyclin F S621G swam significantly shorter distances than uninjected or wildtype controls, and co-expression of PDI restored motor function to near-wildtype levels. PDI protects against ALS/FTD-associated mutant cyclin F in both cellular and in vivo zebrafish models, identifying PDI as a redox-based therapeutic target for CCNF -linked ALS/FTD.
items.titleZh: 蛋白质二硫键异构酶在斑马鱼和细胞模型中保护免受与细胞周期蛋白F相关的ALS/FTD表型
items.summaryZh: 该研究在Neuro-2a细胞和斑马鱼模型中测试了蛋白质二硫键异构酶（PDI）对ALS/FTD相关细胞周期蛋白F S621G突变的保护作用。结果显示，PDI共表达可显著减轻突变型细胞周期蛋白F引起的细胞质错误定位、内质网应激、蛋白酶体功能障碍和凋亡，并改善斑马鱼幼鱼的游动缺陷。研究提示PDI是CCNF相关ALS/FTD的潜在治疗靶点，但尚属临床前动物/细胞实验阶段。
items.insight: 该研究首次将PDI的保护作用扩展至CCNF突变相关ALS/FTD，为这一较小但明确的遗传亚型提供了新的机制干预思路。PDI作为内质网氧化还原伴侣，此前已在SOD1、TDP-43和FUS模型中显示保护作用，本研究进一步支持PDI通路作为跨多个ALS相关蛋白病的共同治疗靶点，值得关注其后续在更成熟模型中的验证及靶向药物开发潜力。

aiRead.studyType: 临床前基础研究（细胞与斑马鱼模型）
aiRead.keyFinding: PDI过表达可显著减轻突变型细胞周期蛋白F S621G诱导的细胞质错误定位、内质网应激、蛋白酶体功能障碍和凋亡，并恢复斑马鱼幼鱼接近野生型的运动功能。
aiRead.limitation: 研究仅使用Neuro-2a细胞系和瞬时转基因斑马鱼模型，尚未在哺乳动物体内模型或患者来源细胞中验证，PDI过表达的长期安全性和递送可行性未评估。
aiRead.watchNext: 后续值得关注PDI在CCNF突变哺乳动物模型中的验证、PDI靶向小分子或基因治疗策略的开发，以及PDI对其他ALS相关蛋白病的广谱保护机制研究。

items.abstractZh: 编码细胞周期蛋白F的CCNF基因突变导致一小部分肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）和额颞叶痴呆（FTD）病例。突变型细胞周期蛋白F从细胞核错误定位至细胞质，损害泛素蛋白酶体系统，破坏内质网（ER）至高尔基体运输，并触发内质网应激和凋亡。蛋白质二硫键异构酶（PDI）是硫氧还蛋白超家族中一种具有氧化还原活性的内质网伴侣蛋白，可保护免受突变型SOD1、TDP-43和FUS诱导的ALS表型，但其对突变型细胞周期蛋白F的活性尚未被研究。为检验PDI过表达是否能预防ALS/FTD相关细胞周期蛋白F S621G突变诱导的细胞和行为表型。将Neuro-2a细胞与mCherry标记的野生型或突变型细胞周期蛋白F S621G以及V5标记的PDI或空载体共转染。通过共聚焦显微镜评估亚细胞定位、XBP-1和CHOP激活、蛋白酶体报告基因（GFPu）积累、核形态和切割型caspase-3免疫反应性。通过受精后48小时的光运动反应评估由细胞周期蛋白F和PDI mRNA共注射产生的瞬时转基因斑马鱼幼鱼。突变型细胞周期蛋白F S621G诱导细胞质错误定位、内质网应激（通过XBP-1和CHOP激活评估）、蛋白酶体功能障碍（通过GFPu积累指示）和凋亡（通过核浓缩和caspase-3激活评估），所有这些均被PDI共表达显著减弱。表达细胞周期蛋白F S621G的斑马鱼幼鱼游动距离显著短于未注射或野生型对照，而PDI共表达将运动功能恢复至接近野生型水平。PDI在细胞和体内斑马鱼模型中均保护免受ALS/FTD相关突变型细胞周期蛋白F的影响，将PDI确定为CCNF相关ALS/FTD的基于氧化还原的治疗靶点。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究于2026年新近发表，首次在细胞和斑马鱼模型中证明PDI对CCNF相关ALS/FTD突变具有保护作用，具有转化医学价值。

items.title: Black Myrobalan ( Terminalia chebula ) as a potential multitarget neuroprotective agent: Translational insights and future directions in neurodegenerative diseases.
items.summary: Myrobalan or Haritaki ( Terminalia chebula Retz. ) has been integrated into Ayurvedic, Unani, and even Tibetan medicine systems for over 2000 years. The "King of Medicines" has traditionally been used for diverse ailments such as digestive issues, wound healing, and general body strengthening. Now, modern medicine is focusing on the myrobalan's potential neuroprotective properties and its use in Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, Huntington's, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) neurodegenerative disorders. These ailments are characterized by some combination of enduring oxidative damage, mitochondrial dysfunction, neuroinflammation, irregular protein aggregation, and progressive neuron cell death. Most of the current treatment options revolve around addressing the symptoms of the diseases, which is insufficient as the underlying disease continues to progress. There is an urgent need to devise therapies that work simultaneously on multiple disease pathways. Some of the noted secondary metabolites in T. chebula include hydrolyzable tannins like chebulinic and chebulagic acid as well as corilagin. Others occur as phenolic acids such as gallic and ellagic acid and flavonoids quercetin and kaempferol. Moreover, glycosides, sterols, and a wide range of alkaloids are also present. A number of these compounds are known to possess multifunctional biological properties like scavenging ROS, activating Nrf2/ARE signaling, downregulating pro-inflammatory mediators through blockade of NF-κB, and exerting protective effects on the mitochondria, as well as modulating apoptosis via Bcl-2 and caspases. T. chebula extracts and some isolated compounds have also been shown to improve cognitive function, reduce neuroinflammation, and protect dopaminergic neurons, and ameliorate neurotoxic effects of amyloid-β or α-synuclein through in vitro and in vivo animal studies. A review of the contributions from the phytochemistry, mechanism of action, preclinical, translational, and adjunctive applications of Terminalia chebula in neurodegenerative disease therapy is presented here.
items.titleZh: 诃子（Terminalia chebula）作为潜在的多靶点神经保护剂：神经退行性疾病中的转化启示与未来方向
items.summaryZh: 这是一篇综述，系统梳理诃子（Terminalia chebula）的植物化学成分及其在神经退行性疾病中的多靶点神经保护潜力。文章指出，诃子中的鞣质、酚酸、黄酮和生物碱等成分在体外和动物实验中可清除活性氧、激活 Nrf2/ARE、抑制 NF-κB 介导的神经炎症、保护线粒体并调节凋亡，部分提取物和单体还显示改善认知、保护多巴胺能神经元和减轻 Aβ/α-突触核蛋白毒性。作者强调现有疗法多为对症治疗，亟需多通路干预策略，并讨论了诃子用于 ALS 等疾病的转化与辅助治疗前景。
items.insight: 对 ALS 研究者而言，这篇综述的价值在于把诃子及其单体成分的抗氧化、抗炎、线粒体保护和蛋白稳态调节作用与 ALS 相关的多条病理通路对应起来，为多靶点候选药物筛选和辅助治疗设计提供植物化学与机制线索。但需注意，现有证据主要来自体外和动物研究，尚不能推断临床疗效。

aiRead.keyFinding: 诃子提取物及诃子酸、诃黎勒酸、corilagin、没食子酸、鞣花酸、槲皮素、山奈酚等成分在体外和动物研究中显示抗氧化、抗神经炎症、线粒体保护、调节凋亡及减轻 Aβ/α-突触核蛋白毒性的多靶点作用。
aiRead.limitation: 证据主要来自体外和动物实验，缺乏临床疗效数据；综述未提供系统检索和定量合并分析，不能据此判断对人 ALS 的获益。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注诃子单体或标准化提取物在 ALS 模型中的剂量、生物利用度、靶点验证及后续转化研究，尤其是能否进入临床前候选药物开发。

items.abstractZh: 诃子（Myrobalan 或 Haritaki，Terminalia chebula Retz.）已被整合进阿育吠陀、尤纳尼乃至藏医药体系超过2000年。这种“药物之王”传统上用于治疗消化问题、伤口愈合和全身强壮等多种病症。如今，现代医学正关注诃子的潜在神经保护特性及其在阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、亨廷顿病和肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）等神经退行性疾病中的应用。这些疾病以持续性氧化损伤、线粒体功能障碍、神经炎症、异常蛋白聚集和进行性神经元细胞死亡中的某些组合为特征。目前大多数治疗方案围绕缓解疾病症状，这并不充分，因为 underlying disease 仍在持续进展。迫切需要设计能同时作用于多条疾病通路的疗法。T. chebula 中一些值得注意的次生代谢产物包括可水解鞣质如诃子酸（chebulinic acid）和诃黎勒酸（chebulagic acid）以及 corilagin。其他包括酚酸如没食子酸和鞣花酸，以及黄酮类槲皮素和山奈酚。此外，还含有糖苷、甾醇和多种生物碱。其中许多化合物已知具有多功能生物学特性，如清除 ROS、激活 Nrf2/ARE 信号、通过阻断 NF-κB 下调促炎介质、对线粒体发挥保护作用，以及通过 Bcl-2 和 caspases 调节凋亡。T. chebula 提取物和一些分离化合物也已在体外和体内动物研究中显示可改善认知功能、减少神经炎症、保护多巴胺能神经元，并改善淀粉样蛋白-β 或 α-突触核蛋白的神经毒性效应。本文综述了 Terminalia chebula 在神经退行性疾病治疗中的植物化学、作用机制、临床前、转化和辅助应用方面的贡献。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述新近整合了诃子多靶点神经保护机制与 ALS 等神经退行性疾病的转化潜力，为多通路候选干预提供参考。

items.title: Engineered peroxisomes and patient-derived iPSC models as potential biomaterial platforms for precision neuroprotection in oxidative stress-driven central nervous system disorders.
items.summary: Peroxisomes couple hydrogen peroxide metabolism to lipid homeostasis, making their functions relevant to neurological disease and to the design of intracellular catalytic biomaterials. However, the strength of disease-specific evidence and the functions reproduced by current materials vary substantially. This narrative review distinguishes modified biological peroxisomes from artificial and biomimetic platforms and evaluates how patient-derived induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC) models could support their development. We examine membrane chemistry, substrate permeability, enzyme retention, catalytic activity, cell targeting, blood-brain barrier transport, three-dimensional tissue penetration, and intracellular fate. We separate the established causal role of peroxisomal defects in primary peroxisomal disorders from associative or unresolved findings in Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Kleefstra syndrome is discussed as a hypothesis-generating neurodevelopmental model, without assuming a primary peroxisomal defect. Published artificial-organelle studies establish selected catalytic and delivery capabilities, but do not validate the integrated patient-specific CNS therapeutic strategy proposed here. We therefore outline a staged evaluation framework that combines materials characterization with mechanistic controls, differentiated neural cultures, multicellular models, animal pharmacology, safety, and manufacturing assessment. Comparison with conventional antioxidant carriers, plasmalogen supplementation, and PPAR agonists should determine whether compartmentalized catalysis offers a measurable advantage. We provide a platform classification, a disease-resolved evidence hierarchy, and a set of controls and measurable endpoints intended to make peroxisome-inspired constructs comparable across studies. Clinical development will require evidence of disease-relevant benefit beyond ROS reduction and an acceptable therapeutic window.
items.titleZh: 工程化过氧化物酶体与患者来源iPSC模型作为氧化应激驱动中枢神经系统疾病精准神经保护的潜在生物材料平台
items.summaryZh: 这篇叙述性综述系统梳理了工程化过氧化物酶体及仿生催化平台在氧化应激相关中枢神经系统疾病中的潜在应用。作者强调需区分原发性过氧化物酶体病中的因果证据与ALS等神经退行性疾病中的关联性证据，并提出利用患者iPSC模型和分阶段评估框架来推动该领域向精准神经保护发展。
items.insight: 该综述为ALS研究者提供了一个批判性框架：过氧化物酶体靶向的催化生物材料尚处于早期探索阶段，需通过患者iPSC模型和严格对照验证其超越简单抗氧化剂的疾病修饰潜力，避免将关联性发现误读为治疗证据。

aiRead.keyFinding: 过氧化物酶体启发的催化平台在ALS等疾病中的治疗潜力尚缺乏疾病特异性因果证据，需通过iPSC模型和分阶段评估框架进行严格验证。
aiRead.limitation: 为叙述性综述，未提供原始实验数据；对ALS的讨论主要基于关联性证据，未验证所提出的整合治疗策略。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续利用患者iPSC来源神经模型验证过氧化物酶体靶向构建体在ALS中疾病相关获益的研究。

items.abstractZh: 过氧化物酶体将过氧化氢代谢与脂质稳态偶联，使其功能与神经系统疾病以及细胞内催化生物材料的设计相关。然而，疾病特异性证据的强度以及当前材料所再现的功能差异很大。这篇叙述性综述区分了修饰的生物过氧化物酶体与人工及仿生平台，并评估了患者来源的诱导多能干细胞（iPSC）模型如何支持其开发。我们考察了膜化学、底物通透性、酶保留、催化活性、细胞靶向、血脑屏障转运、三维组织穿透以及细胞内命运。我们将过氧化物酶体缺陷在原发性过氧化物酶体病中的既定因果作用与阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病和肌萎缩侧索硬化中的关联性或未解决发现区分开来。Kleefstra综合征作为假设生成性神经发育模型进行讨论，不假定存在原发性过氧化物酶体缺陷。已发表的人工细胞器研究确立了选定的催化和递送能力，但并未验证本文提出的整合患者特异性CNS治疗策略。因此，我们概述了一个分阶段评估框架，将材料表征与机制对照、分化神经培养、多细胞模型、动物药理学、安全性和生产评估相结合。与常规抗氧化载体、缩醛磷脂补充和PPAR激动剂的比较应确定区室化催化是否提供可测量的优势。我们提供了平台分类、疾病分辨的证据层级以及一套对照和可测量终点，旨在使过氧化物酶体启发的构建体在不同研究间具有可比性。临床开发将需要超越ROS降低的疾病相关获益证据和可接受的治疗窗。
items.frontierRationale: 该文新近提出将工程化过氧化物酶体与患者iPSC模型结合作为精准神经保护平台，并强调在ALS等疾病中需区分因果与关联证据，具有转化方法学价值。

items.title: The Boron-Neuron Connection: The Potential of Boron-Containing Molecules for Treating Incurable Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis.
items.summary: Boron (B), a group 13 metalloid, has emerged as a versatile element at the intersection of chemistry, biology, and medicine. Its electron-deficient nature and ability to reversibly interconvert between trigonal planar (sp 2 ) and tetrahedral (sp 3 ) geometries enable dynamic covalent interactions with biological nucleophiles, making boron-containing compounds (BCCs) attractive pharmacophores that selectively interact with reactive oxygen species (ROS) and are ROS-responsive for therapeutic development. BCCs possess antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and metal-chelating properties that make them attractive candidates for neurodegenerative diseases. Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), a fatal and multifactorial motor neurodegenerative disorder, is characterized by oxidative stress, neuroinflammation, mitochondrial dysfunction, and metal dyshomeostasis, providing a strong rationale for exploring boron-based therapeutics. This review examines current literature on B chemistry, pharmacology, and translational applications, with emphasis on mechanisms relevant to ALS pathogenesis. This review focuses on ROS-responsive B scaffolds, blood-brain barrier (BBB) permeability, neuroprotective mechanisms, hormonal modulation, metal chelation, and emerging preclinical evidence supporting boron-based interventions. BCCs represent a promising yet underexplored therapeutic platform for ALS and related neurodegenerative disorders. Their ROS-responsive, redox-modulating, and neuroprotective properties, combined with favorable CNS drug-like pharmacokinetics, offer a mechanistically distinct approach to disease modification. Emerging preclinical evidence strongly supports further translational investigation.

items.titleZh: 硼-神经元连接：含硼分子治疗不可治愈性肌萎缩侧索硬化的潜力
items.summaryZh: 这是一篇综述，系统梳理含硼化合物在ALS治疗中的潜在价值。文章指出，硼元素独特的化学性质使其能够设计出响应活性氧（ROS）的分子，这类分子具有抗氧化、抗炎和螯合金属的能力，恰好针对ALS中的氧化应激、神经炎症、线粒体功能障碍和金属失衡等病理环节。综述还讨论了血脑屏障穿透性、神经保护机制和激素调节等转化相关议题，认为含硼分子是ALS领域一个有前景但研究尚不充分的方向，现有支持证据主要来自临床前研究。
items.insight: ALS药物开发长期缺乏能同时针对氧化应激、神经炎症和金属失衡的多靶点策略。含硼分子因其ROS响应性和可逆共价结合特性，提供了一种机制上不同于现有候选药物的疾病修饰思路。这篇综述值得跟踪，因为它把分散的硼化学、药代和神经保护证据整合到ALS病理框架下，并明确指出了血脑屏障通透性和临床前证据链等关键转化瓶颈，有助于判断该平台是否具备进入临床开发的条件。

aiRead.studyType: 叙述性综述（非系统综述/荟萃分析），总结含硼化合物的化学、药理学及ALS相关临床前证据
aiRead.keyFinding: 含硼化合物具有ROS响应性、抗氧化、抗炎和金属螯合特性，并具备良好的中枢神经系统药物样药代动力学，临床前证据支持其作为ALS疾病修饰的候选平台。
aiRead.limitation: 证据均来自临床前研究，尚无临床疗效或安全性数据；作为叙述性综述，未说明文献检索与筛选方法，也未对证据质量进行系统评估。

items.abstractZh: 硼（B）是一种第13族类金属，已成为化学、生物学和医学交叉领域中的多功能元素。其缺电子性质以及在三角平面（sp2）和四面体（sp3）几何构型之间可逆互变的能力，使其能够与生物亲核试剂发生动态共价相互作用，从而使含硼化合物（BCCs）成为有吸引力的药效团，可选择性地与活性氧（ROS）相互作用，并具有ROS响应性，可用于治疗开发。BCCs具有抗氧化、抗炎和金属螯合特性，使其成为神经退行性疾病的有吸引力候选物。肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种致命的多因素运动神经退行性疾病，以氧化应激、神经炎症、线粒体功能障碍和金属稳态失衡为特征，为探索硼基治疗提供了强有力的理由。本综述考察了关于B化学、药理学和转化应用的当前文献，重点关注与ALS发病机制相关的机制。本综述聚焦于ROS响应性硼骨架、血脑屏障（BBB）通透性、神经保护机制、激素调节、金属螯合以及支持硼基干预的新兴临床前证据。BCCs代表了一个有前景但尚未充分探索的ALS及相关神经退行性疾病治疗平台。其ROS响应性、氧化还原调节和神经保护特性，加上良好的中枢神经系统药物样药代动力学，提供了一种机制上独特的疾病修饰方法。新兴的临床前证据强烈支持进一步的转化研究。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述于2026年发表，系统提出ROS响应性含硼分子作为ALS疾病修饰的新机制平台，具有明确的转化探索价值。

items.title: Novel compounds induce AChR clustering and improve motor function in myasthenia gravis animal models.
items.summary: The neuromuscular junction (NMJ), the synapse between motor nerves and skeletal muscles, is implicated in the pathogenesis of various neuromuscular disorders, including myasthenia gravis (MG), congenital myasthenia, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Postsynaptic clustering of acetylcholine receptors (AChRs) is crucial for NMJ formation. This process is initiated by agrin, a glycoprotein secreted from motor nerve terminals, which activates muscle-specific tyrosine kinase (MuSK) via its coreceptor, low-density lipoprotein receptor-related protein 4 (Lrp4), and thereby activates downstream signaling pathways that induce AChR clustering. MG is an autoimmune disease characterized by the production of autoantibodies against NMJ components such as AChR, MuSK, and Lrp4, which leads to impaired neuromuscular transmission and motor dysfunction. In this study, we identified orally active small-molecule compounds that promote AChR clustering through the Lrp4-MuSK signaling axis. Knockdown experiments demonstrated that Lrp4 was responsible for the compounds to induce AChR clustering. The compounds induced MuSK phosphorylation following the compound treatment in C2C12 cells and improved motor function and increased muscle volume in both MuSK-MG mice and AChR-MG rat models. Together, these findings identify orally active small molecules that potentiate Lrp4-MuSK signaling and highlight a pharmacological strategy to modulate NMJ function for MG and related neuromuscular disorders.
items.titleZh: 新型化合物诱导AChR聚集并改善重症肌无力动物模型的运动功能
items.summaryZh: 研究团队筛选出可口服的小分子化合物，能通过Lrp4-MuSK信号通路促进乙酰胆碱受体在神经肌肉接头处聚集。细胞实验显示化合物可诱导MuSK磷酸化，动物实验（MuSK-MG小鼠和AChR-MG大鼠）中化合物改善了运动功能并增加肌肉体积。该策略针对神经肌肉接头功能调节，与ALS共享NMJ病理机制，但目前仅为动物和细胞层面证据。
items.insight: ALS与MG等神经肌肉接头疾病共享NMJ功能障碍这一病理环节，该研究提供的Lrp4-MuSK通路口服小分子工具可为ALS中NMJ保护策略提供可借鉴的药理学思路，值得关注其后续在ALS模型中的验证。

items.abstractZh: 神经肌肉接头（NMJ）是运动神经与骨骼肌之间的突触，参与多种神经肌肉疾病的发病机制，包括重症肌无力（MG）、先天性肌无力综合征和肌萎缩侧索硬化。突触后乙酰胆碱受体（AChR）的聚集对NMJ形成至关重要。该过程由运动神经末梢分泌的糖蛋白agrin启动，agrin通过其共受体低密度脂蛋白受体相关蛋白4（Lrp4）激活肌肉特异性酪氨酸激酶（MuSK），进而激活下游信号通路诱导AChR聚集。MG是一种自身免疫性疾病，其特征是产生针对NMJ组分（如AChR、MuSK和Lrp4）的自身抗体，导致神经肌肉传递受损和运动功能障碍。本研究鉴定出通过Lrp4-MuSK信号轴促进AChR聚集的口服活性小分子化合物。敲低实验证明Lrp4是这些化合物诱导AChR聚集所必需的。在C2C12细胞中，化合物处理后可诱导MuSK磷酸化；在MuSK-MG小鼠和AChR-MG大鼠模型中，化合物改善了运动功能并增加了肌肉体积。总之，这些发现鉴定出增强Lrp4-MuSK信号的口服活性小分子，并提示了一种通过调节NMJ功能治疗MG及相关神经肌肉疾病的药理学策略。
items.frontierRationale: 新近鉴定出可口服的Lrp4-MuSK信号增强小分子，并在两种MG动物模型中验证运动功能改善，为ALS相关NMJ功能障碍的药物干预提供了可转化的候选工具。

items.title: TNIP1 acts as an aggrephagy receptor that assembles clearance machinery for protein aggregate removal.
items.summary: Selective autophagy receptors recognize and recruit harmful intracellular components to autophagosomes for degradation, and their dysfunction is linked to neurodegeneration, metabolic disorders, and cancer. Here, we identified TNFAIP3 interacting protein 1 (TNIP1) as an aggrephagy receptor implicated in neurodegenerative diseases. TNIP1 accumulated at polyubiquitinated protein aggregates upon proteotoxic stress. Genetic depletion of TNIP1 reduced protein aggregate clearance and increased axonal degeneration under proteotoxic stress. Mechanistically, TNIP1 enhanced protein aggregate clearance by assembling aggrephagy receptors, such as SQSTM1/p62 and TAX1BP1, onto protein aggregates. Gene expression analysis revealed that TNIP1 expression levels are reduced in patients with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) with TAR DNA-binding protein 43 (TDP-43) inclusion pathology. Additionally, an ALS-associated TNIP1 mutant exhibited impaired association with TDP-43 aggregates and failed to rescue their autophagy-mediated degradation. These findings establish TNIP1 as an aggrephagy receptor and reveal its potential role as a therapeutic target for ALS and other proteinopathies.

items.titleZh: TNIP1作为聚集自噬受体组装清除机器以去除蛋白聚集体
items.summaryZh: 该研究在细胞和患者样本层面鉴定TNIP1为一种新的聚集自噬受体，负责将p62、TAX1BP1等受体招募到多泛素化蛋白聚集体上以促进清除；TNIP1缺失会削弱聚集体清除并加重轴突变性。ALS伴TDP-43包涵体病理患者中TNIP1表达降低，且一个ALS相关TNIP1突变体无法有效结合TDP-43聚集体并促其自噬降解。
items.insight: 该研究把TDP-43蛋白病与一条可操作的聚集自噬通路连接起来：TNIP1不仅是清除机器的组织者，其ALS相关突变还直接损害对TDP-43聚集体的识别。对ALS研究者而言，这提供了一个可追踪的候选靶点，值得在患者来源模型和体内模型中验证增强TNIP1聚集自噬功能能否减轻TDP-43病理和轴突损伤。

items.abstractZh: 选择性自噬受体识别并招募有害的细胞内组分至自噬体进行降解，其功能障碍与神经退行性疾病、代谢紊乱和癌症相关。本研究鉴定TNFAIP3相互作用蛋白1（TNIP1）为一种与神经退行性疾病相关的聚集自噬受体。在蛋白毒性应激下，TNIP1积聚于多泛素化蛋白聚集体。遗传性敲低TNIP1会减少蛋白聚集体清除，并在蛋白毒性应激下增加轴突变性。机制上，TNIP1通过将SQSTM1/p62和TAX1BP1等聚集自噬受体组装到蛋白聚集体上，增强蛋白聚集体清除。基因表达分析显示，在伴有TAR DNA结合蛋白43（TDP-43）包涵体病理的肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）患者中，TNIP1表达水平降低。此外，一个ALS相关的TNIP1突变体与TDP-43聚集体的结合受损，且无法挽救其自噬介导的降解。这些发现确立了TNIP1作为聚集自噬受体的身份，并揭示其作为ALS及其他蛋白病治疗靶点的潜在作用。
items.frontierRationale: 新近鉴定的聚集自噬受体TNIP1在ALS伴TDP-43病理患者中表达降低，其ALS相关突变损害聚集体清除，具有明确的ALS相关性和转化潜力。

items.title: Impaired discrimination of negative facial emotions in pure motor ALS.
items.summary: Emotion recognition deficits in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) remain debated. We investigated whether patients with pure motor ALS (without cognitive and behavioural disturbances) and without clinically relevant mood disturbances are impaired in discriminating negative facial emotions, using a test without ceiling effects. This cross-sectional study included 35 patients with pure motor ALS, based on the revised Strong criteria and operationalised using the Edinburgh Cognitive and Behavioural ALS Screen (ECAS), without clinically relevant mood disturbances, alongside 35 age-, sex-, and education-matched cognitively and psychiatrically healthy controls. All participants completed a shortened five-emotion version of the Facial Emotion Intensity Rating Test - Congruent and Incongruent and the Facial Sex Matching Task (FSMT), a brief screening measure of non-emotional facial discrimination. Pure motor ALS patients showed poorer discrimination among negative facial emotions than healthy controls (p = 0.011, Cohen's d = 0.63). The group difference did not differ significantly across anger, fear, sadness, and disgust (p = 0.178). Similarly, the group difference in discrimination among negative emotions did not differ significantly from that in discrimination between negative emotions and happiness (p = 0.459). The two groups did not differ significantly on the FSMT. Discrimination of negative facial emotions was impaired in patients with pure motor ALS, suggesting that classification based on ECAS screening may underestimate social-cognitive involvement. Our findings are compatible with the concept of an ALS-frontotemporal spectrum disorder. Whether impaired emotion discrimination relates to additional cognitive or behavioural impairment remains to be determined. The clinical utility and reliability of our measure require further study.
items.titleZh: 纯运动型ALS患者对负面面部情绪的辨别能力受损
items.summaryZh: 这项横断面研究比较了35例无认知行为障碍、无临床相关情绪障碍的纯运动型ALS患者与35名匹配健康对照，发现患者在负面面部情绪辨别上表现更差（效应量中等），但在非情绪面部辨别任务上无差异。结果提示，即使ECAS筛查正常的纯运动型ALS患者也可能存在社会认知损害，支持ALS-额颞谱系障碍概念。
items.insight: 该研究提示，以ECAS筛查定义的“纯运动型ALS”可能仍包含社会认知受损者，这对ALS临床分型和试验入组标准有直接影响；情绪辨别任务或可作为补充筛查工具，但需进一步验证其可靠性和临床效用。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）中的情绪识别缺陷仍存在争议。我们研究了无认知和行为障碍、且无临床相关情绪障碍的纯运动型ALS患者，在使用无天花板效应的测试时，是否在辨别负面面部情绪方面存在损害。这项横断面研究纳入了35例纯运动型ALS患者，依据修订版Strong标准诊断，并使用爱丁堡认知和行为ALS筛查（ECAS）进行操作化评估，无临床相关情绪障碍，同时纳入35名年龄、性别和教育程度匹配的认知和精神健康对照。所有参与者完成了面部情绪强度评分测试-一致与不一致的简化五情绪版本，以及面部性别匹配任务（FSMT），后者是一种简短暂短的非情绪面部辨别筛查工具。纯运动型ALS患者在负面面部情绪辨别方面表现差于健康对照（p = 0.011，Cohen's d = 0.63）。该组间差异在愤怒、恐惧、悲伤和厌恶之间无显著差异（p = 0.178）。同样，负面情绪间辨别的组间差异与负面情绪和快乐之间辨别的组间差异无显著差异（p = 0.459）。两组在FSMT上无显著差异。纯运动型ALS患者对负面面部情绪的辨别受损，提示基于ECAS筛查的分类可能低估了社会认知受累。我们的发现与ALS-额颞谱系障碍的概念相符。情绪辨别受损是否与额外的认知或行为损害相关仍有待确定。我们测量工具的临床效用和可靠性需要进一步研究。
items.frontierRationale: 新近研究提示ECAS筛查可能低估纯运动型ALS的社会认知受累，为ALS-额颞谱系障碍的早期识别和分型提供转化线索。

items.title: The neuro-inflammaging triangle: a self-amplifying circuit of protein pathology, senescence-associated secretory phenotype and innate immunity in neurodegenerative disease.
items.summary: Neurodegenerative diseases, including Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, frontotemporal dementia and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, share common pathological features, including abnormal protein aggregation, chronic neuroinflammation and progressive neuronal loss. Ageing is the strongest risk factor, accompanied by a chronic, mild inflammatory state called 'inflammaging,' partly due to senescent cells producing senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP) factors. Innate immune DNA- and danger-sensing pathways, most notably the cyclic GMP-AMP synthase-stimulator of interferon genes (cGAS-STING) pathway and NOD-like receptor family, pyrin domain containing 3 (NLRP3) inflammasomes, convert cellular injury into chronic neuroinflammation. Here, we propose that protein pathology, SASP, and innate immune activation form a self-amplifying triangular circuit leading to age-related neurodegeneration. We present the cellular and molecular basis of each part and how microglia, astrocytes, oligodendrocyte precursor cells and neurons contribute. We outline treatment strategies, including senolytics, senomorphics, innate immune pathway inhibitors and metabolic restoration, and identify unresolved questions, including the reversibility of post-mitotic neuronal senescence, the relative contribution of each cell type and the translational challenge of interrupting the cycle. Collectively, the neuro-inflammaging triangle theory shifts focus from individual pathogenic entities to the self-amplifying circuit that sustains them, offering a unified mechanistic model to advance our understanding and treatment of age-related neurodegeneration.

items.titleZh: 神经炎性衰老三角：神经退行性疾病中蛋白病理、衰老相关分泌表型与先天免疫的自我放大环路
items.summaryZh: 这是一篇综述性文章，提出“神经炎性衰老三角”模型：异常蛋白聚集、衰老细胞分泌的SASP因子以及cGAS-STING、NLRP3等先天免疫通路激活，三者相互放大，共同驱动年龄相关神经退行性变。文章梳理了小胶质细胞、星形胶质细胞、少突胶质前体细胞和神经元在其中的作用，并讨论了senolytics、senomorphics、先天免疫抑制剂和代谢恢复等干预思路，同时指出神经元衰老可逆性、各细胞贡献比例和环路中断的转化难题仍待解决。
items.insight: 该文把ALS与其他年龄相关神经退行性疾病放在同一机制框架下，强调蛋白病理与神经炎症之间的自我放大环路，而非单一致病蛋白。对ALS研究者而言，这提示cGAS-STING、NLRP3和SASP可能成为跨疾病的干预节点，也提醒在ALS模型中评估衰老细胞清除或免疫通路抑制时需关注环路反馈和细胞类型特异性。

aiRead.keyFinding: 提出蛋白病理、SASP和先天免疫激活构成自我放大的“神经炎性衰老三角”，共同驱动年龄相关神经退行性变，并涵盖ALS。
aiRead.limitation: 为理论整合与文献综述，未提供新的原始实验数据；神经元衰老可逆性、各细胞类型相对贡献及环路中断的转化可行性尚未解决。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续针对cGAS-STING、NLRP3、SASP或senolytics在ALS模型及临床前研究中的验证，以及能否证明中断该环路可延缓神经退行性变。

items.abstractZh: 包括阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、额颞叶痴呆和肌萎缩侧索硬化在内的神经退行性疾病具有共同的病理特征，包括异常蛋白聚集、慢性神经炎症和进行性神经元丢失。衰老是最强的风险因素，伴随一种称为“炎性衰老”的慢性轻度炎症状态，部分由衰老细胞产生衰老相关分泌表型（SASP）因子所致。先天免疫DNA感知和危险感知通路，尤其是环鸟苷酸-腺苷酸合成酶-干扰素基因刺激因子（cGAS-STING）通路和含NOD样受体家族pyrin结构域3（NLRP3）炎症小体，将细胞损伤转化为慢性神经炎症。在此，我们提出蛋白病理、SASP和先天免疫激活形成一个自我放大的三角环路，导致年龄相关神经退行性变。我们阐述各部分的细胞和分子基础，以及小胶质细胞、星形胶质细胞、少突胶质前体细胞和神经元如何参与。我们概述治疗策略，包括衰老细胞清除药物、衰老表型调节药物、先天免疫通路抑制剂和代谢恢复，并指出未解决的问题，包括终末分化神经元衰老的可逆性、各细胞类型的相对贡献以及中断该环路的转化挑战。总体而言，神经炎性衰老三角理论将焦点从单个致病实体转向维持这些实体的自我放大环路，为推进对年龄相关神经退行性变的理解和治疗提供了统一的机制模型。
items.frontierRationale: 该文于2026年提出将蛋白病理、SASP与先天免疫整合为自我放大环路的统一模型，直接涵盖ALS，并为神经炎症靶向干预提供转化思路。

items.title: Lower frequency ECoG features improve longitudinal stability of speech and hand-grasp detection in a patient with progressive ALS.
items.summary: Achieving long-term decoding stability is a critical challenge for chronicintracranial brain-computer interfaces (BCIs). High-gamma (HG) activity fromintracranial recordings is the standard signal for BCI control, and lower-frequency featurescan enhance HG decoding performance. This study evaluated the longitudinal stability ofspeech and hand-grasp detection models using individual and joint spectral features, andthe local motor potential (LMP).Approach. Longitudinal data from a single participant implanted with two 64-channelECoG arrays were used to evaluate the long-term stability of logistic regression models forspeech and hand-grasp detection. Models were trained on individual frequency bands andon the LMP, a time-domain low-frequency feature, and evaluated over 21 months forspeech and 13 months for grasp. The best-performing band features were then combinedinto multi-band models and analyzed for their spatial contributions.Main Results. The LMP yielded the most accurate single feature models in both tasks(speech 93.8%, grasp 99.4%) and showed little or no decline. Multi-band modelscombining HG with lower frequency bands were substantially more stable than HG-onlymodels and outperformed the LMP models for speech but not grasp. HG accuracydegraded strongly for both tasks (speech:-4.3 percentage points per 100 days, or pp/100d,grasp:-3.4 pp/100d). HG+beta for speech showed a negligible decline (-0.5 pp/100d,95.6% ±0.06% overall), and for grasp, delta alone showed remarkable stability (+0.5pp/100d), while HG+beta+delta maintained 98.2 ±0.09% overall accuracy with flatperformance (+0.0 pp/100d). The advantage of the multi-band models increased overtime, reaching +20.6 pp for speech and +10.2 pp for grasp in the last 100 days.Significance. Incorporating lower-frequency neural activity yields more stable long-termspeech and grasp detection than HG alone. These findings indicate that lower-frequencyand multi-band features may reduce recalibration requirements for simple BCI tasks, andmay complement the precision control provided by HG activity.
items.titleZh: 低频ECoG特征提高进行性ALS患者语音与抓握检测的纵向稳定性
items.summaryZh: 在一名进行性ALS患者中，研究者利用植入的64通道ECoG阵列比较了不同频段特征对语音和抓握解码的长期稳定性。高伽马（HG）信号随时间的解码准确率明显下降，而低频特征（如局部运动电位LMP、delta、beta）单独或与HG联合使用时稳定性更好，多频带模型在后期优势更明显。这提示低频特征可能减少BCI重新校准的需求。
items.insight: 该研究直接针对ALS患者慢性BCI的长期稳定性难题，证明低频特征可延缓解码性能衰退，对推进实用化BCI具有转化意义；但证据来自单例患者，需在更多患者中验证。

aiRead.studyType: 单例纵向观察性机制研究
aiRead.keyFinding: 低频特征（LMP、delta、beta）及多频带模型比仅高伽马特征在语音和抓握解码中表现出更好的长期稳定性，多频带模型优势随时间增加。
aiRead.limitation: 仅一名进行性ALS患者，样本量极小，结果外推需谨慎；未涉及临床疗效终点。
aiRead.watchNext: 需要在更多ALS患者中验证低频特征的长期稳定性，并探索自适应解码策略以减少重新校准需求。

items.abstractZh: 实现长期解码稳定性是慢性颅内脑机接口（BCI）面临的关键挑战。颅内记录的高伽马（HG）活动是BCI控制的标准信号，而低频特征可增强HG解码性能。本研究评估了使用个体和联合频谱特征以及局部运动电位（LMP）的语音和手抓握检测模型的纵向稳定性。方法：使用一名植入两个64通道ECoG阵列的参与者纵向数据，评估语音和手抓握检测的逻辑回归模型的长期稳定性。模型分别在单个频带和LMP（一种时域低频特征）上训练，语音评估21个月，抓握评估13个月。然后将表现最佳的频带特征组合成多频带模型，并分析其空间贡献。主要结果：LMP在两个任务中均产生最准确的单特征模型（语音93.8%，抓握99.4%），且几乎没有或没有下降。将HG与低频带组合的多频带模型比仅HG模型稳定得多，在语音上优于LMP模型，但在抓握上未优于LMP模型。HG准确率在两个任务中均强烈退化（语音：每100天-4.3个百分点，即pp/100d；抓握：-3.4 pp/100d）。语音的HG+beta显示可忽略的下降（-0.5 pp/100d，总体95.6% ±0.06%），抓握中仅delta表现出显著稳定性（+0.5 pp/100d），而HG+beta+delta保持总体准确率98.2 ±0.09%，性能平稳（+0.0 pp/100d）。多频带模型的优势随时间增加，在最后100天语音达到+20.6 pp，抓握达到+10.2 pp。意义：纳入低频神经活动比仅HG产生更稳定的长期语音和抓握检测。这些发现表明，低频和多频带特征可能减少简单BCI任务的重新校准需求，并可能补充HG活动提供的精确控制。
items.frontierRationale: 新近纵向数据显示低频ECoG特征可显著提升ALS患者BCI解码的长期稳定性，具有明确的转化价值。

items.title: Carbon dot-based nanomaterials in neurodegeneration: addressing neurobiological barriers and targeting challenges.
items.summary: Neurodegenerative diseases, including Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, Huntington's disease, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, represent a major global health challenge due to their progressive nature and limited therapeutic options. One of the primary obstacles to treating these disorders is the blood-brain barrier (BBB), which restricts the delivery of most therapeutic agents into the central nervous system. In recent years, carbon-based nanomaterials, particularly carbon dot (CD) nanostructures, have emerged as promising platforms for neurological applications owing to their ultrasmall size, BBB-crossing ability, and anti-inflammatory and neuroprotective properties, in addition to tunable surface chemistry, strong photoluminescence, and favorable biocompatibility. This review provides a comprehensive overview of recent research developments in the application of CD-based nanomaterials, including carbon nanodots, carbon quantum dots, graphene quantum dots, and carbon polymer dots, for the potential treatment of neurodegenerative diseases. The synthesis strategies and carbonization approaches used to produce these carbon nanomaterials are discussed, along with their physicochemical properties relevant to neurobiological applications, such as particle size, surface functionalization, heteroatom doping, optical properties, and stability in biological environments. Furthermore, the mechanisms by which CD-based nanomaterials can traverse the BBB are examined, including receptor-mediated and adsorptive-mediated transcytosis pathways. In addition, their applications are discussed, with particular focus on their roles in bioimaging, biosensing, inhibition of pathological protein aggregation, antioxidative activity, and targeted drug delivery. Finally, key challenges related to toxicity, biodistribution, large-scale synthesis, and clinical translation are discussed, along with future perspectives for the development of multifunctional theranostic platforms. Overall, use of CD-based nanomaterials represents a promising emerging strategy for overcoming neurobiological barriers and enabling the development of next-generation nanotherapeutics for the management of neurodegenerative diseases.
items.titleZh: 碳点基纳米材料在神经退行性疾病中的应用：应对神经生物学屏障与靶向挑战
items.summaryZh: 这是一篇综述，系统总结了碳点类纳米材料（碳纳米点、碳量子点、石墨烯量子点、碳聚合物点）在阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、亨廷顿病和肌萎缩侧索硬化等神经退行性疾病中的潜在应用。文章重点讨论其合成方法、理化性质、穿越血脑屏障的机制（受体介导和吸附介导转胞吞），以及在生物成像、生物传感、抑制病理蛋白聚集、抗氧化和靶向递药方面的作用，同时指出毒性、生物分布、规模化合成和临床转化等挑战。
items.insight: 对ALS研究者而言，该综述的价值在于把“如何让治疗分子进入中枢神经系统”这一核心递送难题与碳点纳米平台的最新进展放在一起梳理，尤其涉及跨BBB机制和抑制病理蛋白聚集。它有助于判断纳米递送策略在ALS治疗中的可行边界，但属于综述层面，不提供新的临床疗效证据。

aiRead.studyType: 综述（非原始研究，非临床试验）
aiRead.keyFinding: 碳点基纳米材料因超小尺寸、可调表面化学和跨BBB能力，被综述为神经退行性疾病潜在诊疗平台，涉及生物成像、抑制蛋白聚集、抗氧化和靶向递药。
aiRead.limitation: 仅为文献综述，未提供原始实验数据或临床疗效证据；毒性、生物分布、规模化合成和临床转化仍是未解决问题。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续针对ALS模型的碳点递送原始研究，尤其是跨BBB效率、长期安全性和与疾病靶点的结合验证。

items.abstractZh: 神经退行性疾病，包括阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、亨廷顿病和肌萎缩侧索硬化，因其进行性本质和治疗选择有限，构成重大全球健康挑战。治疗这些疾病的主要障碍之一是血脑屏障（BBB），它限制了大多数治疗药物进入中枢神经系统。近年来，碳基纳米材料，尤其是碳点（CD）纳米结构，因其超小尺寸、穿越BBB能力、抗炎和神经保护特性，以及可调表面化学、强光致发光和良好生物相容性，已成为神经应用的有前景平台。本综述全面概述了CD基纳米材料（包括碳纳米点、碳量子点、石墨烯量子点和碳聚合物点）在神经退行性疾病潜在治疗中应用的最新研究进展。讨论了制备这些碳纳米材料的合成策略和碳化方法，以及其与神经生物学应用相关的理化性质，如粒径、表面功能化、杂原子掺杂、光学性质和生物环境中的稳定性。此外，审查了CD基纳米材料穿越BBB的机制，包括受体介导和吸附介导的转胞吞途径。还讨论了其应用，特别关注其在生物成像、生物传感、抑制病理性蛋白聚集、抗氧化活性和靶向药物递送中的作用。最后，讨论了与毒性、生物分布、大规模合成和临床转化相关的关键挑战，以及开发多功能诊疗一体化平台的未来前景。总体而言，CD基纳米材料的使用代表了一种有前景的新兴策略，用于克服神经生物学屏障并推动下一代纳米治疗药物的发展，以管理神经退行性疾病。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述新近整合了碳点纳米材料跨越血脑屏障并靶向神经退行性疾病病理过程的研究进展，对ALS药物递送和转化开发具有参考价值。

items.title: Living drug carriers: Microbial and bioengineered platforms redefining precision therapeutic and immunomodulatory delivery.
items.summary: Microbial living therapeutics are a new class of drug-delivery materials that combine synthetic biology, immunomodulation, and advanced formulations to achieve controllable therapeutic effects in space and time. In the broad field of living drug-delivery systems, therapeutic platforms include engineered microorganisms, mammalian immune cells, stem cells, viral vectors, extracellular-vesicle-producing cells, and hybrid bioengineered living materials. This review focuses on engineered microbial living drug carriers, including genetically modified bacteria and probiotic platforms, because these systems uniquely integrate programmable biosensing, in situ therapeutic synthesis, adaptive immunomodulation, and controllable drug delivery within a single living chassis. Designed microbes and consortia possess other unique functions, such as microenvironment sensing, programmed control of gene expression, and long-lasting in situ manufacturing of therapeutic payloads not available with small-molecule or biologic drugs. Recent progress in microbial chassis engineering, genetic circuit design, and biocontainment has enabled fine-tuning of immune responses, metabolic pathways, and tissue-specific signaling in a wide range of diseases from cancer to autoimmune and inflammatory diseases, to metabolic and endocrine disorders, neuro-immunological conditions (e.g., amyotrophic lateral sclerosis), infectious diseases including infectious threats without existing approved vaccines (Zika virus) as well as rare genetic disorders. Advances in formulation science, including encapsulation technologies, biomaterial-microbe hybrids, and stimuli-responsive release platforms, have enabled overcoming key translation challenges concerning microbial viability, biodistribution, safety, and controlled activation in complex physiological milieus like the gut (for enteric pathogens), tumor microenvironment (for oncolytic organisms), or injured tissues (for tissue-targeting organisms). Increasing numbers of clinical-stage LBP studies are now conducted under good manufacturing practice, standardized QC, and clinical conditions, ranging from emerging PK, biodistribution, and biomarker-driven studies to those adapted to living entities. The addition of host microbiome profiling, multi-omics analysis, and computational modeling is anticipated to increase therapeutic predictability and patient stratification. Taken together, these advances position live microbial therapeutics as programmable biological medicines with the potential for adaptive, context-specific administration and warrant further clinical development and increased integration within precision medicine-informed therapeutic approaches.
items.titleZh: 活体药物载体：微生物与生物工程平台重新定义精准治疗与免疫调节递送
items.summaryZh: 该综述系统总结了工程化微生物作为活体药物载体的最新进展，涵盖基因修饰细菌和益生菌平台。这类平台可在体内实现可编程传感、原位药物合成和免疫调节，并已拓展至癌症、自身免疫病、代谢病及神经免疫疾病（包括ALS）等领域。制剂科学和生物防护技术的进步正在解决微生物存活、靶向分布和安全性等转化难题，多项临床阶段研究已在GMP和标准化质控下开展。
items.insight: 虽然这是一篇综述而非ALS原始研究，但它将ALS明确列为微生物活体治疗药物的潜在适应症，提示工程菌平台可能通过调节神经免疫、递送治疗载荷或干预肠-脑轴来影响ALS病程。对ALS研究者而言，值得关注的是该领域如何从概念走向临床阶段研究，以及生物分布、安全性和生物防护等关键问题在神经疾病场景下如何解决。

aiRead.studyType: 叙述性综述（非原始研究）
aiRead.keyFinding: 工程化微生物活体药物载体整合了可编程传感、原位治疗合成和免疫调节，已在包括ALS在内的多种疾病模型中展现概念可行性，并逐步进入临床阶段研究。
aiRead.limitation: 本文为综述，未提供针对ALS的原始实验数据或临床疗效结果；微生物活体治疗在ALS中的安全性、靶向性和生物防护仍需专门研究验证。

items.abstractZh: 微生物活体治疗药物是一类新型药物递送材料，结合合成生物学、免疫调节和先进制剂技术，在时间和空间上实现可控的治疗效果。在活体药物递送系统的广泛领域中，治疗平台包括工程化微生物、哺乳动物免疫细胞、干细胞、病毒载体、产生细胞外囊泡的细胞以及混合生物工程活体材料。本综述聚焦于工程化微生物活体药物载体，包括基因修饰细菌和益生菌平台，因为这些系统独特地在单一活体底盘内整合了可编程生物传感、原位治疗合成、适应性免疫调节和可控药物递送。设计的微生物及菌群 consortium 具有其他独特功能，如微环境感知、基因表达的编程控制以及小分子或生物药物无法实现的长效原位治疗载荷制造。微生物底盘工程、遗传回路设计和生物防护的最新进展使得在从癌症到自身免疫和炎症性疾病、代谢和内分泌疾病、神经免疫疾病（例如肌萎缩侧索硬化）、传染病（包括尚无获批疫苗的传染病威胁，如寨卡病毒）以及罕见遗传病的广泛疾病中，精细调节免疫反应、代谢途径和组织特异性信号传导成为可能。制剂科学的进步，包括封装技术、生物材料-微生物杂合体和刺激响应释放平台，使得克服微生物活力、生物分布、安全性以及在复杂生理环境（如肠道（针对肠道病原体）、肿瘤微环境（针对溶瘤生物）或受损组织（针对组织靶向生物））中可控激活等关键转化挑战成为可能。越来越多的临床阶段 LBP 研究现在在良好生产规范、标准化质量控制和临床条件下进行，范围从新兴的药代动力学、生物分布和生物标志物驱动研究到适应活体实体的研究。宿主微生物组分析、多组学分析和计算建模的加入预计将提高治疗可预测性和患者分层。综上所述，这些进展将活体微生物治疗药物定位为可编程生物药物，具有适应性、情境特异性给药的潜力，并值得进一步临床开发以及更多地整合到精准医学指导的治疗方法中。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述新近系统梳理了工程化微生物活体药物在包括ALS在内的神经免疫疾病中的转化前景，并讨论了GMP条件下临床阶段研究的关键挑战，具有跨领域转化参考价值。

items.title: Beyond neurones: cardiac involvement in motor neurone disease.
items.summary: Motor neurone disease (MND) is a fatal neurodegenerative disorder defined by the progressive loss of upper and lower motor neurones. This degeneration leads to muscle wasting and weakness, most prominently affecting the upper and lower limbs, the bulbar musculature responsible for speech and swallowing, as well as the respiratory muscles (Feldman et al., 2022). As the disease advances, affected individuals experience profound functional decline, loss of independence, and ultimately respiratory failure, which remains the leading cause of death (Kiernan et al., 2021). Despite advances in understanding the molecular and cellular mechanisms of MND, effective disease‑modifying treatments are limited and there is no cure. Management therefore focuses largely on symptomatic treatment and multidisciplinary supportive care to maintain quality of life (Simon et al., 2015). The long-standing view of MND as a disease confined to the motor system is increasingly being challenged. Emerging evidence from human and rodent studies suggests that other organ systems, such as the heart, may also be affected, raising the possibility that cardiac involvement is a clinically relevant but under‑recognised feature of the disease.

items.abstractZh: 运动神经元病（MND）是一种致死性神经退行性疾病，其特征是上、下运动神经元的进行性丢失。这种变性导致肌肉萎缩和无力，最显著地影响上下肢、负责言语和吞咽的延髓肌群以及呼吸肌（Feldman等，2022）。随着疾病进展，患者经历严重功能衰退、丧失独立性，并最终出现呼吸衰竭，后者仍是主要死因（Kiernan等，2021）。尽管在理解MND的分子和细胞机制方面取得进展，有效的疾病修饰治疗仍然有限，且尚无治愈方法。因此管理主要集中于对症治疗和多学科支持护理以维持生活质量（Simon等，2015）。MND长期被视为局限于运动系统的疾病，这一观点正日益受到挑战。来自人类和啮齿动物研究的新兴证据提示，其他器官系统如心脏也可能受累，提出心脏受累是该疾病临床相关但未被充分认识的特征的可能性。
items.frontierRationale: 新近综述整合人类与啮齿动物证据，提示心脏受累可能是ALS/MND被低估的临床相关特征，具有转化研究价值。

items.title: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis treated with the modified Bu-Shen-Jian-Pi decoction (mBSJP): Multicenter study.
items.summary: To investigate whether the modified Bu-Shen-Jian-Pi decoction (mBSJP) is more efficacious than the hitherto used and promoted BSJP formula in the treatment of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). ALS is a fatal neurodegenerative disease with no satisfactory treatment option. Currently, there are few palliative care methods that can significantly delay the progression of the disease, and the efficacy of the herbal treatments used hitherto has also been unsatisfactory. A total of 165 patients with ALS who met the diagnostic criteria after screening were randomly allocated into two groups, a modified Bu-Shen-Jian-Pi decoction group referred to as the mBSJP group and the placebo group. Clinical efficacy and side effects were evaluated during a 16-week observation period. Primary outcomes included Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis Symptom Score in Integrative Treatment Scale (ALS-SSIT) and Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis Rating Scale-Revised (ALSFRS-R) scores, and secondary observation parameters were 36-Item Short-Form Health Survey Questionnaire (SF-36) and forced vital capacity (FVC). A total of 73 patients in the mBSJP group and 71 patients in the placebo group completed the trial. At the end of the 16 th week of treatment, there were significant statistical differences observed between the two groups in values for both the ALS-SSIT and the ALSFRS-R scores showing that mBSJP significantly delayed progression of the disease and appearance of symptoms compared to the administration of placebo. Treatment of ALS with mBSJP delays disease progression and is recommended as a treatment option for ALS in regions where the use of traditional Chinese medicine is regulated and approved.
items.titleZh: 改良补肾健脾汤（mBSJP）治疗肌萎缩侧索硬化症：多中心研究
items.summaryZh: 这项多中心随机对照试验将165例ALS患者分为改良补肾健脾汤（mBSJP）组和安慰剂组，进行16周观察。完成试验者分别为73例和71例。结果显示，mBSJP组在ALS-SSIT和ALSFRS-R两项主要评分上均优于安慰剂组，提示其可能延缓疾病进展和症状出现；SF-36和FVC为次要指标。原文建议在传统中药使用受监管和批准的地区将mBSJP作为治疗选择。需注意，该结论来自单篇随机对照试验，尚需独立重复验证。
items.insight: 这是少见的针对ALS的中药复方多中心随机安慰剂对照试验，直接以ALS-SSIT和ALSFRS-R为主要终点，为中药在ALS中的疗效评价提供了可参考的试验设计范例。ALS研究者可关注其复方成分、安慰剂设计和16周观察期是否足以捕捉疾病进展差异，以及结果能否被独立重复。

items.abstractZh: 探讨改良补肾健脾汤（mBSJP）在治疗肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）方面是否比迄今使用和推广的BSJP方剂更有效。ALS是一种致死性神经退行性疾病，目前尚无令人满意的治疗选择。目前能够显著延缓疾病进展的姑息治疗方法很少，迄今使用的草药疗法疗效也不理想。共165例符合诊断标准并经过筛查的ALS患者被随机分配到两组：改良补肾健脾汤组（简称mBSJP组）和安慰剂组。在16周观察期内评估临床疗效和副作用。主要结局包括综合治疗量表肌萎缩侧索硬化症状评分（ALS-SSIT）和肌萎缩侧索硬化评定量表修订版（ALSFRS-R）评分，次要观察指标为36项简短健康调查问卷（SF-36）和用力肺活量（FVC）。mBSJP组73例患者和安慰剂组71例患者完成了试验。在治疗第16周末，两组在ALS-SSIT和ALSFRS-R评分值上均观察到显著的统计学差异，表明与安慰剂相比，mBSJP显著延缓了疾病进展和症状出现。mBSJP治疗ALS可延缓疾病进展，建议在传统中药使用受到监管和批准的地区将其作为ALS的治疗选择。
items.frontierRationale: 该多中心随机安慰剂对照试验以ALS特异性功能量表为主要终点，为中药复方治疗ALS提供了新近的随机对照证据，具有潜在的转化参考价值。
